related_questions.question: How bad does COVID have to be to be hospitalized?
related_questions.snippet: Most people with COVID-19 infections don't need to go to the hospital and will have a smooth recovery at home. Severe COVID symptoms that need medical attention include difficulty breathing, confusion or disorientation, and a bluish discoloration in the lips or hands.

related_questions.question: Which is the greatest risk factor for hospitalization or death from COVID-19?
related_questions.snippet: Age is the strongest risk factor for severe COVID-19 outcomes. Patients with one or multiple certain underlying medical conditions are also at higher risk. Additionally, being unvaccinated or not being up to date on COVID-19 vaccinations also increases the risk of severe COVID-19 outcomes.
